description: This file implements the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application. It defines the main home screen layout, including a top navigation bar with categories and a vertical list of content rows with horizontal carousels. The code manages UI setup, styling, focus navigation, and mock data generation for content.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment representing the home screen with navigation categories and content rails.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Data model for a row of content, including its title and list of items.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data model representing an individual content item with id, title, and image URL.

classes.name: MockContentData
classes.description: Object providing mock data generation for content items.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and returns the root view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components such as top navigation and content rails after view creation.

methods.name: setupBrand
methods.description: Configures the brand TextView with styled text and content description.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Sets up the horizontal top navigation bar with categories and focus behavior.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Prepares the vertical list of content rows with mock data and focus handling.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears binding references to prevent memory leaks.
